project_type: Bash automation + AWS CLI harness around SGLang inference benchmarking. No application code, no package manifest. The repo is a test plan (README.md, 663 lines, Chinese) plus two bash scripts in scripts/.
language: Bash (shell). Embedded Python 3 heredocs inside the bash scripts for JSON parsing. No Python package, no requirements.txt.
build_system: None. There is no Makefile, no package.json, no CI config, no .github/ directory. Nothing compiles. 'Build' means syntax validation of the shell scripts.
test_framework: None exists today. There are zero tests in the repo. This task must introduce one: a plain-bash test harness under tests/ that puts stub executables (aws, nvidia-smi, mdadm, docker, curl) on PATH and runs the bootstrap script against them. shellcheck and bats are NOT installed in the sandbox; shellcheck can be obtained via `docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/mnt" koalaman/shellcheck:stable` (network is open) or by downloading the static binary from the shellcheck GitHub release. If neither works, fall back to `bash -n` for every script and say so explicitly in the feature findings.
build_command: bash -n scripts/*.sh scripts/bootstrap/*.sh  (plus shellcheck if obtainable, see test_framework)
verification_instructions: 1. `bash -n` every .sh file in scripts/ and tests/ - must exit 0. 2. `bash tests/run-tests.sh` - all cases pass. 3. `bash scripts/preflight.sh --region us-east-2 --az us-east-2a` - must complete and print a PASS/FAIL table with zero AWS spend (it only calls read-only describe-* APIs plus run-instances --dry-run). 4. `bash scripts/launch-bench-ec2.sh --stage full --dry-run` - must render user-data, validate it with `bash -n`, and call run-instances with --dry-run, exiting 0 on the expected 'DryRunOperation' response. 5. No stage may launch a real instance unless CONFIRM_SPEND=yes is set in the environment; assert this with a test case that runs without CONFIRM_SPEND and confirms the script refuses.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None checked in today. results/ contains only .gitkeep and must stay that way - benchmark output is written at runtime and is gitignored except .gitkeep. The user-data blob rendered by launch-bench-ec2.sh is generated at run time into a temp file; do NOT check a rendered copy in.

AWS CLI v2.33.15 is at /usr/bin/aws and is already authenticated as arn:aws:sts::077090643075:assumed-role/kiro/... in account 077090643075. jq and docker CLI are on PATH. python3 is 3.11.14 via pyenv shims. contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md exists. Conventions inferred from git log: commit subjects are Conventional Commits with Chinese bodies, e.g. 'feat: 更新 Spot 实价数据 + 新增自动化 benchmark 脚本 + 清理 POC 集群'. Match that style. Work on the existing branch harden-ec2-bench-runner (already created off test-plan). Commit your work. Do NOT push and do NOT open a PR - the orchestrator handles that.
key_patterns: scripts/run-benchmark.sh is the house style to imitate: `#!/usr/bin/env bash` + `set -euo pipefail`, a banner comment block, an all-caps `VAR="${VAR:-default}"` config section, a `usage()` heredoc with Chinese help text, a `while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]` case-based long-option parser, a `log()` helper that prints `[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] $*`, a `cleanup()` registered with `trap cleanup EXIT`, and `# ===` section separators with `Step a)` / `Step b)` labels. Results are written to results/ as both a machine-readable JSON and a human-readable _summary.txt, named ${INSTANCE_TYPE//./-}_tp${TP_SIZE}_${TIMESTAMP}. scripts/compare-results.sh consumes that JSON shape: it reads metadata.instance_type, metadata.tp_size, metadata.region, metadata.timestamp, and for each of custom_benchmark and official_benchmark reads .config.{input_tokens,output_tokens,num_prompts,max_concurrency}, .results.* and .pass. Any new result writer MUST keep that exact schema or compare-results.sh silently reports N/A.

postmortem_facts.what_happened: A prior Kiro session launched bare EC2 i-0459cbc565ec484f6 (p5en.48xlarge, us-east-2a, spot ~$26.67/hr, AMI ami-0b80a5f61a0bca5dd = Deep Learning Base OSS Nvidia Driver GPU AMI Ubuntu 22.04 20260804) from 2026-08-07T15:09:55Z to 2026-08-08T04:24:16Z = 13h14m ~= $353, and produced nothing. results/ is still empty, there are no commits after 4138e92, and no S3 PutObject in CloudTrail.
postmortem_facts.why_it_was_unrecoverable: No user-data, no IAM instance profile (therefore no SSM shell), key pair tpot-bench-key private key existed only inside the dead session and is lost, root volume had DeleteOnTermination=true. When the session hung there was no way to reach the box and nothing had been persisted off it.
postmortem_facts.telemetry: NetworkIn 315.32 GB total with two ~151 GB bursts (08-07 15:15 and 08-08 00:25) = the checkpoint downloaded twice. EBSWriteBytes 121 GB for attempt 1 but only 19.21 GB for attempt 2 despite 150.98 GB downloaded = signature of a full disk. CPUUtilization peaked at 8.34% of 192 vCPUs and fell to 0.08% at several points; most hours wrote only ~10 MB. No GPU metrics existed at all (no CloudWatch agent, no DCGM, no IAM role to PutMetricData), so GPU idleness is inference from CPU/disk/network, not proof.
postmortem_facts.primary_cause_disk: p5en.48xlarge ships 30.4 TB of local NVMe instance store (8 x 3800 GB ssd, NvmeSupport=required, confirmed via describe-instance-types). The launch mounted NONE of it and used a single 200 GB gp3 root volume, leaving roughly 175 GB usable after OS and the ~12.75 GB container image. README section 9.1 already warns '所有 manifest 需按环境修改，否则权重会写到小根盘' and the launch ignored it.
postmortem_facts.secondary_cause_checkpoint: CONFIRMED during planning via the HuggingFace API and the SGLang cookbook. deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash (the instruct checkpoint) has config.json expert_dtype=fp4 with quantization_config.quant_method=fp8, i.e. FP4 MoE experts + FP8 attention/dense, and totals 159.6 GB / 148.6 GiB across 73 files - which matches the observed ~151 GB download. H200 is Hopper SM90 and has no native FP4. Per the cookbook, Hopper has exactly two options: (a) run the original FP4 checkpoint through the W4A16 Marlin MoE kernels, which is TP-only and cannot use DP-attention or DeepEP, or (b) use the pre-repackaged FP8 checkpoint sgl-project/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-FP8, which is 294.1 GB / 273.9 GiB across 55 files and unlocks DP-attention + DeepEP. Option (b) cannot physically fit on a 200 GB root volume, and option (a) fits only barely, which is exactly the disk-full pattern in the telemetry. Note deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Base IS pure FP8 (expert_dtype=fp8) but the cookbook states the *-Base repos are for further pre-training only and must not be used for chat or tool calling, so it is not a valid substitute.

upstream_findings.source: https://lmsysorg.mintlify.app/cookbook/autoregressive/DeepSeek/DeepSeek-V4 fetched during planning; README section 10 designates this the 上游权威.
upstream_findings.cli_and_image: The cookbook uses the `sglang serve ...` CLI and states one image, lmsysorg/sglang:latest, covers B200/B300/GB200/GB300/H100/H200/RTX PRO 6000. It references SGLang v0.5.16 as current. scripts/run-benchmark.sh pins lmsysorg/sglang:v0.5.12.post1-cu130 and invokes `python3 -m sglang.launch_server`.
upstream_findings.speculative_decoding: For the original Flash checkpoint the verified recipe is EAGLE with low-latency preset steps=3, eagle-topk=1, draft-tokens=4, which matches README section 12.6. The correct flag is `--speculative-algorithm EAGLE`. scripts/run-benchmark.sh currently emits `--speculative-algo EAGLE`, which is not the documented flag name and is a likely hard startup failure. config.json confirms num_nextn_predict_layers=1, i.e. the MTP/draft head is bundled in the checkpoint, so no --speculative-draft-model-path is needed.
upstream_findings.dspark_alternative: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 (74 files, 166.9 GB, also expert_dtype=fp4) bundles a DSpark draft head and is enabled with `--speculative-algorithm DSPARK` and NO --speculative-num-steps / --speculative-eagle-topk / --speculative-num-draft-tokens. The cookbook says this variant is verified on 8xB200, 4xGB300 and 4xH200, so it is a second credible H200 recipe.
upstream_findings.cold_start: The cookbook warns the first cold start can take 10-15 minutes while FlashInfer autotunes and SGLang captures draft and verify graphs, and that later starts reuse the cache. Any readiness timeout must exceed this; run-benchmark.sh already uses POD_READY_TIMEOUT=2400.
upstream_findings.hopper_caveats: DP-attention is unavailable on the Hopper FP4/Marlin path. run-benchmark.sh defaults DP_SIZE=8 and ENABLE_DP_ATTENTION=true alongside TP_SIZE=8, which is internally contradictory for the H200 target and must not be passed blindly.
